question.knowledge_point: Identifying the Vertex of a Vertical Parabola Given Its Graph
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/2b78b376173589b18d5e8da73897d9552f41a00aab523c0e76892623b586eb53.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
question.worked_solution:
The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/3c547f893dc1cf2e71c17022ea7c81034214d7aedabe78bf719ebd44b96da329.png)

 

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(4,8).$
